item.title: Vincent Trocheck scores shootout winner as Rangers edge Penguins 3-2
item.description: Vincent Trocheck scored the shootout winner and Igor Shesterkin made 31 saves and the New York Rangers rallied to defeat the Pittsburgh Penguins 3-2 on Saturday.

item.title: US and Israel clash with Iran at emergency Security Council meeting. UN chief condemns attacks
item.description: He said everything must be done to prevent further escalation.

item.title: Greene: Mamdani on wrong side of ‘snowball fight’ with police
item.description: The snowball fight could have been handled better on both sides. This would have been a much nicer story if the cops had been in on it to start, instead of storming in to try to break things up when the gathering got out of hand.

item.title: Ex-Jet Mark Sanchez accused of being on multiple drugs during stabbing incident
item.description: Former Jets quarterback Mark Sanchez may have been under the influence of alcohol and several illicit drugs during his violent encounter in Indianapolis last year.

item.title: Two people stabbed an hour apart in Brooklyn and Manhattan
item.description: In the first incident, a 54-year-old woman was stabbed multiple times in the back around 10:11 p.m. at Grand and Eldridge Sts. on the Lower East Side.

item.title: Tobias Myers set for long relief role with Mets
item.description: Tobias Myers wasn't the headliner of the trade that brought him to the Mets, and he isn't exactly a headliner in spring training, but the right-hander is set to play a valuable role for the club in 2026 as a starter/long reliever.

item.title: Shia LaBeouf arrested again in New Orleans hours after homophobic comments
item.description: Shia LaBeouf has been arrested in New Orleans for the second time in less than two weeks, just hours after discussing how his homophobia led to his first arrest.

item.title: Zuby Ejiofor’s triple-double helps St. John’s blow out Villanova, bounce back from UConn loss
item.description: No. 15 St. John’s bounced back with a commanding 89-57 victory over Villanova at Madison Square Garden to keep pace in the Big East race.

item.title: Asking Eric: Grandson has no motivation; daughter enables him
item.description: Dear Eric: My 26-year-old grandson has never held a job. Three years ago, he earned a master’s degree. Despite his achievement, he engages in all-night computer gaming, sleeps during the day and lacks motivation to seek employment.
